sources: Yahoo NFL training-camp injury tracker, Aug. 24
FantasyPros half-PPR rankings / player news, Aug. 21-24
Reuters NFL injury / transaction reporting, Aug. 23-24
meta.note: Major Aug. 24 changes: Jeanty ankle; Love high ankle; Biadasz season-ending IR; Keaton Mitchell RB2; Nabers rehab progress; Kittle return; Tuten/Rodriguez committee.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.notes: Sprained ankle with unclear return timetable; workload remains elite when healthy.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.notes: High-ankle sprain; out rest of preseason and could start slowly even if active Week 1.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.notes: ACL rehab trending positively; shed non-contact jersey and joined team drills.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.notes: Still a breakout target, but Tyler Biadasz is out for the year and Keaton Mitchell is solidifying RB2 work.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.notes: Jacksonville backfield looks committee-like; Chris Rodriguez has a legitimate lead-role case.

players.name: George Kittle
players.notes: Returned to practice from Achilles rehab; Week 1 outlook improved.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.notes: Preseason usage points to clear RB2 role behind Hampton; committee upside if role expands.

rbCore.name: Ashton Jeanty
rbCore.label: ANKLE / COST WATCH
rbCore.note: Sprained ankle is not believed long-term, but timetable is unclear. Elite workload remains, while Mike Washington Jr. gains contingency value.

rbCore.name: Omarion Hampton
rbCore.label: TARGET — DOWN A NOTCH
rbCore.note: Still a breakout target, but center Tyler Biadasz is out for the season and Keaton Mitchell is emerging as the clear RB2.

rbBackup.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rbBackup.label: JEANTY INSURANCE RISER
rbBackup.note: Jeanty’s ankle sprain makes Washington the most important Raiders contingency back. Camp reports have been positive.

rbBackup.name: Tyler Allgeier
rbBackup.label: IMMEDIATE EARLY-SEASON UPSIDE
rbBackup.note: Jeremiyah Love is out the rest of preseason with a high-ankle sprain. Allgeier is the favorite to lead if Love misses Week 1 or is eased back.

rbBackup.name: Keaton Mitchell
rbBackup.label: CLEAR RB2 / ROLE GROWTH
rbBackup.note: Preseason usage indicates Mitchell is solidifying the RB2 job and could form more of a two-man rotation with Hampton than previously expected.

rbBackup.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
rbBackup.label: JAGUARS ROLE CHALLENGER
rbBackup.note: Jacksonville appears headed toward a committee, and Rodriguez has a legitimate early-down/short-yardage case against Bhayshul Tuten.

wrCore.name: Malik Nabers
wrCore.label: HEALTH TRENDING UP
wrCore.note: Shed the red non-contact jersey and participated in team drills. Week 1 readiness is increasingly plausible, though ACL recovery still adds risk.

wrCore.name: DeVonta Smith
wrCore.label: ROLE EXPANSION
wrCore.note: Returned to full practice and still has a clearer path to career-high volume after A.J. Brown’s departure.

qbCore.name: Justin Herbert
qbCore.label: FORMAT VALUE / OL WATCH
qbCore.note: Five-point passing TDs still help, but center Tyler Biadasz is out for the season, reducing the offensive-line improvement case.

teCore.name: George Kittle
teCore.label: REHAB TRENDING UP
teCore.note: Returned to practice from Achilles rehab. Age still matters, but availability outlook improved materially.
